title: Spicy Chicken Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry recipe combining spicy and savory flavors with chicken and noodles.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the noodles to the skillet and cook until slightly browned, about 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, sugar, and cornstarch.
Pour the soy sauce mixture into the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the hot sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the scallions and serve immediately.
